description: Descrição da vaga Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar atendimento a exames admissionais, demissionais, periódicos, avaliação médica, retorno ao trabalho, mudança de função, encaminhamento ao INSS ou a médicos especialistas. Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Product, GTM, Commercial, BI, CRM, Performance Marketing, Operations and Brand teams to ensure seamless proposition delivery and execution. Ensure alignment between local commercial priorities and the central Sports, Gaming and Social product roadmaps. Support acquisition strategies by optimising propositions and promotional mechanics to improve marketing efficiency and conversion performance. Collaborate with Analytics and Performance teams to build best-in-class reporting frameworks and performance dashboards to inform strategic decision-making. Market & Regulatory Excellence Maintain a strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape and ensure all proposition activity complies with local requirements and responsible gaming standards. title: Mechanical & Rotating Engineer
description: Airswift is seeking a Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore) to work in Rio de Janeiro in a permanent position with an Oil and Gas Company. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Act as a Technical Authority (Integrity) to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA/RCA) and develop reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems), ensuring compliance with company standards and international codes, increasing MTBF and reducing downtime. Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with company standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT). Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned. Ensure complete documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders. Monitor the performance of rotating equipment using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection. Supervise and execute Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement condition-based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime. Develop and implement reliability and maintenance (RCM) strategies, with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost. Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems; recommend corrective actions. Identify and manage problematic components, conduct disposal plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements. Lead the ACR for recurring failures and problems using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify the effectiveness of actions. Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements. Provide daily technical support to Operations and Maintenance areas to resolve machine problems, unplanned downtime, and optimize control/operating parameters. Offer guidance for commissioning/start-up, operations, reviews, and updates of controls/monitoring for rotating equipment. Support capital projects by reviewing maintainability and reliability specifications and ensuring correct installation/alignment according to API/AGMA/ISO standards. Support the preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (ART) and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and systems. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. MBA/Postgraduate degree in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus. Advanced English required. Experience in operation, maintenance, or reliability of rotating equipment in the Oil and Gas sector (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery. Solid knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services. Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and fault diagnosis. Proven experience in troubleshooting and field condition monitoring. Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machine design, lubrication, mechanical seals (including dry gas seals). Rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis. Practical knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816). In‑depth knowledge of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, dry gas seal systems, and gearboxes. Certification in vibration analysis (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desirable; certifications in oil analysis/thermography are an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MÉDICO DO TRABALHO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description: Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar atendimento a exames admissionais, demissionais, periódicos, avaliação médica, retorno ao trabalho, mudança de função, encaminhamento ao INSS ou a médicos especialistas. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Medicina do Trabalho. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico do Trabalho. title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description: Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department Technical & Infrastructure Location Brazil Position Summary The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world‑class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards. The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly oversee the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding, and non‑competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums. Key Responsibilities Oversee the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during the planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament. Collaborate with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensure that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Work closely with the Non‑Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project. Serve as the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department. Oversee contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites. Constantly monitor the budgetary impact of dressing operations and report updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. Provide strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offer expertise when required. Adhere to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Maintain daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaise with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Present to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required. Attend department‑specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites. Input into the site‑specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management. Act as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project. Participate in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites. Assist with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensure the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites. Contribute to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Possibly relocate to a Host City for up to three months to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Minimum 4+ years of experience delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games, etc., or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.). Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large‑scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi‑faceted events and projects. Experience managing providers of services for world‑class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) in Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs, as the role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems. Will attend site visits and be away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Good understanding of application security and secure engineering practices. Leadership of engineering teams with 5+ direct reports and a track record of building and developing talent. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, operating with ownership and autonomy. Practice data‑driven decision making in delivery and engineering management. Ability to operate effectively in environments involving transaction‑heavy, reliability‑sensitive, or fintech‑related systems. Nice to Have Proficiency in more than one programming language. Experience with large‑scale distributed systems in high‑growth or high‑traffic environments. Exposure to travel tech, e‑commerce, marketplace, or fintech platforms. title: A CARREIRA DO FARMACÊUTICO DE ASSUNTOS REGULATÓRIOS
description: A carreira farmacêutica especializada em regulação sanitária de indústrias, distribuidoras e empresas do varejo farmacêutico é uma das mais valorizadas pelo mercado de trabalho. Esta carreira possui grande projeção profissional no meio industrial e em órgãos reguladores, em que existe maior complexidade nas atividades realizadas pelo profissional, consequentemente as maiores remunerações estão em localidades que possuem polos industriais farmacêuticos, como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Brasília e Pernambuco. Ser especialista em regulação sanitária exige do profissional aptidão para tarefas administrativas, conhecimentos aprofundados em legislação sanitária nacional e internacional e capacidade de negociação, liderança, comunicação e gestão. O inglês é indispensável e o espanhol pode ser um diferencial para grandes empresas farmacêuticas brasileiras, que detêm filiais na América Latina. A competição profissional nesta carreira é acirrada, pois a atuação não é restrita ao farmacêutico por força de lei. Dessa forma, o profissional formado em Farmácia compete com praticamente todos os profissionais de saúde, advogados e até administradores de empresas. Responsabilidades na indústria de medicamentos e em consultorias especializadas: Acompanha os processos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Analisa relatórios de qualificação e validação; Acompanha e avalia o mercado e os lançamentos de novos produtos dos concorrentes; Administra e executa o processo de registro de novos produtos farmacêuticos na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa); Acompanha diariamente as publicações da Anvisa no Diário Oficial da União (D.O.U.); Discute novas resoluções em Consultas Públicas na Anvisa; Acompanha e implementa novas resoluções e regras sanitárias; Recebe e acompanha auditoria sanitária; Administra o processo de revalidação do registro de produtos; Acompanha o sistema de atendimento ao cliente (SAC) e registros do setor de farmacovigilância; Orienta o departamento de marketing em publicidades e propagandas; Orienta o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Verifica os registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento. Responsabilidades nos órgãos reguladores: Acompanha o cumprimento de normas e legislação por parte das empresas; Propõe e debate com o mercado o desenvolvimento de novas resoluções e regulamentações; Fiscaliza a qualidade e o seguimento de regras na produção de produtos farmacêuticos; Fiscaliza a comercialização de produtos farmacêuticos; Regulamenta o preço dos medicamentos; Regulamenta os tipos de medicamentos e suas formas de comercialização; Regulamenta o comércio farmacêutico e suas características de consumo. Orienta e acompanha o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Cuida dos registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento; Orienta e fiscaliza condições de estoque e armazenamento de produtos; Acompanha e fiscaliza condições de transporte e distribuição de produtos farmacêuticos. Áreas de atuação: Indústrias farmacêuticas; Empresas de logística farmacêutica; Consultorias especializadas; Vigilância sanitária de estados e municípios (Visa). O curso de graduação em Farmácia é o mais indicado para profissionais que desejam seguir carreira em Assuntos Regulatórios principalmente na indústria de medicamentos. É importante ressaltar que profissionais que desejam atuar em agências reguladoras, como a Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa), é necessária a aprovação em concurso público específico. description: Digital Product Manager Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. With the biggest, most ambitious FIFA Women’s World Cup™ on the horizon, this is your chance to help shape the next generation of digital experiences and grow the Women’s game! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first‑party data strategies. Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament‑time digital operations, delivering high‑traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross‑functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Provide clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross‑functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer‑first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI‑driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data‑driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. YOUR PROFILE Education & Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline Relevant product development philosophies, e.g., Agile, are essential Relevant project management qualifications, e.g., PRINCE2, highly beneficial Work Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, demonstrating end‑to‑end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct‑to‑consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. description: Event Experiences Marketing Manager - FIFA Trophy Tour Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA27 is established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). THE POSITION The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ Trophy Tour exists to build anticipation and engagement ahead of the tournament, serving as a promotional platform to drive ticket sales, tourism, and global visibility. By bringing the Trophy to communities across Brazil and the world, it demonstrates FIFA’s truly global mission while positioning Brazilian host cities as vibrant, capable, and welcoming destinations at the heart of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Trophy Tour Manager will lead the planning, marketing and delivery of the Host Country phase of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Trophy Tour across Brazil, ensuring a cohesive, high‑impact and locally relevant execution across all Host Cities. They will also support moments on the Global Tour that require local stakeholders, particularly Brazilian Embassies in the 32 participating Member Associations. Acting as the central point of coordination in‑market, this role will drive alignment across FIFA’s global project team in Zurich, local stakeholders and all relevant internal functions. Working in close collaboration with the Experiential Marketing Manager in Zurich, the Manager will ensure that all FIFA Trophy Tour activities are strategically aligned, culturally relevant, and delivered to FIFA standards. The role will also support the global leg of the FIFA Trophy Tour where required, ensuring continuity and consistency between international and Host Country phases. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the development and execution of the Host Country FIFA Trophy Tour strategy and marketing approach across Brazil including all Host Cities. Ensure alignment with the overall FIFA Trophy Tour strategy, adapting where needed to maximize local relevance and impact. Act as the primary point of contact for the eight Host Cities, coordinating planning, timelines, and delivery expectations. Integrate with the wider FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ project, identifying opportunities to amplify impact across other initiatives. Stakeholder management & governance Manage relationships with Host Cities, local authorities, agencies and key stakeholders, acting as FIFA’s representative in‑market. Serve as the source of truth on local context, sensitivities and opportunities, proactively informing the global team. Lead cross‑functional coordination across FIFA internal teams (Operations, Legends, Digital, Communications, Brand, Partnerships and Media) ensuring all workstreams are aligned, integrated and delivered against a unified plan. Maintain consistent alignment and information flow with the Zurich‑based FIFA team, proactively managing dependencies, timelines and decision‑making across global and local stakeholders. Oversee and approve local plans, including venues, run‑of‑show, schedules and promotional activities. Ensure compliance with FIFA rights, brand guidelines and partner commitments. Marketing, communications & content Oversee the development and execution of local promotional plans across channels (digital, media, partners, on‑the‑ground) in alignment with the broader global marketing and communications plan. Ensure Host City activations are culturally relevant, locally resonant and aligned with the overall campaign narrative. Inspire Host Cities and hosts to invest as many resources as possible to deliver the best FIFA Trophy Tour events. Lead coordination of media activities in‑market, approved by the project team and FIFA Communications. Oversee content capture, approvals and distribution across FIFA channels and stakeholders (including .com, CRM, VNRs and social platforms). On‑site delivery & operations Represent FIFA on‑site across selected FIFA Trophy Tour stops in Brazil and support on global stops if needed. Oversee delivery of FIFA communications, promotional and content activities, ensuring high‑quality execution and stakeholder experience. Ensure proper representation, handling and protection of FIFA assets, including the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ Trophy and FIFA Legend. Coordinate on‑site stakeholders to ensure smooth operations, including media, partners and local teams. Reporting & performance tracking Monitor progress of the FIFA Trophy Tour across Host Cities and ensure timely escalation of risks or issues. Provide regular and comprehensive reporting on activities, performance and key learnings. Contribute to post‑event evaluation and recommendations for future FIFA Trophy Tours. Global coordination Support the Zurich‑based project team on the global leg where required. Coordinate with FIFA27 Government Relations to pitch FIFA Trophy Tour opportunities to Brazilian Government representatives and embassies for inclusion in both phases of the tour to facilitate their involvement in official events and support local engagement opportunities. Ensure continuity and consistency between the global and Host Country phases, capturing and sharing key learnings to inform delivery across the tour. Se você é um profissional que deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais e oportunidades de crescimento, **esta é a sua chance**.**Junte-se à Venancio e contribua diretamente para a evolução da nossa operação logística!**---### Requirements##### StudiesPostgraduate - Specialization/MBALogisticsProduction/industrial engineering---### Valued##### Professional experienceBetween 1 and 3 years---### About VenancioBEM-VINDOS À MAIS AMADA DO RIO! QUEM SOMOS Somos a Venancio, uma marca carioca que há mais de 46 anos coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. Com mais de 140 lojas físicas e mais de 5.000 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios, Volta Redonda, Cabo Frio e São Pedro da Aldeia. Em 2014, expandimos nossa atuação com a Hospinova, empresa do Grupo Venancio especializada no mercado hospitalar e distribuição farmacêutica. E para sustentar nosso crescimento, contamos com três Centros de Distribuição estrategicamente localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte. O QUE NOS TORNA ÚNICOS - Nossa essência carioca - O acolhimento genuíno no atendimento - A busca constante por inovação Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e atuamos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importa. E a Venancio não para: até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos crescendo, sempre com o compromisso de oferecer atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar. CRESÇA COM A GENTE! Para levar as melhores sensações aos nossos clientes, precisamos de pessoas que trabalhem realizadas e comprometidas em alcançar a excelência no nosso atendimento. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha fazer parte desse time que transforma vidas todos os dias. #VemSerVenancio #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Engenheiro Comercial
description: Atuar como responsável técnico-comercial pelo atendimento às demandas dos clientes, sendo encarregado de receber solicitações, entender necessidades técnicas, realizar visitas em campo, propor soluções elétricas, elaborar orçamentos técnicos e comerciais, além de direcionar, revisar e validar os orçamentos e projetos elétricos desenvolvidos pela equipe, assegurando a viabilidade técnica, econômica e operacional das soluções propostas. O cargo é estratégico e operacional, exigindo forte domínio técnico, visão de custos, capacidade de comunicação com clientes e integração entre orçamento, projeto e fabricação de painéis elétricos de baixa tensão. PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES DO CARGO Elaborar projetos técnicos de painéis elétricos de baixa tensão (e soluções associadas), e também orientar/revisar os projetos feitos pela equipe. Elaborar orçamentos técnicos e comerciais, fazendo: Levantamento de quantitativos de materiais, equipamentos e serviços; Composição de custos (diretos, indiretos, margens/BDI); Análise de prazos, riscos e viabilidade técnico- econômica. Coordenar tecnicamente a equipe de orçamento e projetos: Definindo o escopo e premissas; Revisando e validando entregas; Garantindo padrão técnico, coerência e qualidade. Atender o cliente tecnicamente: Realizando (ou validando) visitas técnicas; Entendendo a necessidade real do cliente (técnica, operacional e normativa); Traduzindo isso em escopo claro e solução técnica adequada. Propor solução técnica: Definindo a arquitetura do painel, proteções, comandos, automação; Escolhendo componentes e soluções compatíveis com custo, norma e prazo. Avaliar viabilidade e riscos: Técnicos, financeiros, produtivos e de prazo; Antecipar problemas antes de virar erro em fábrica ou campo. Responsável pelo fechamento e acompanhamento das propostas: Ciclo completo das propostas, desde a solicitação inicial até a definição da solução técnica e entrega do orçamento ao cliente e posterior follow-up, até que o ciclo do orçamento seja encerrado; Garantindo alinhamento entre escopo, orçamento, projeto e execução. Interpretar diagramas elétricos e aplicar normas técnicas e de segurança (NR-10, ABNT, IEC), assegurando a viabilidade e segurança das soluções. Sugerir melhorias em processos, padrões técnicos, soluções de engenharia e procedimentos de orçamentação. Definir prioridades e distribuir demandas entre os integrantes da equipe de orçamento e projetos, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e qualidade técnica das entregas. Formação superior em Engenharia Elétrica ou Engenharia de Controle e Automação. Registro ativo no CREA (exigência legal para a função). Conhecimento de sistemas elétricos de baixa tensão. Vivência comprovada em elaboração de orçamentos técnicos. Domínio de softwares de desenho e projeto elétrico (AutoCAD, EPLAN, CAD elétrico ou similar). Conhecimentos em automação e instrumentação (definição de sensores, atuadores, lógica de controle, PLCs, etc.). Conhecimento em normas de segurança elétrica, normas técnicas aplicáveis (NR10, SPDA, aterramento, proteção, etc.). Leitura e interpretação de desenhos mecânicos / estruturas / montagem. Familiaridade com ERP, preferencialmente Omie. Necessário experiência em projetos e orçamentos de sistemas elétricos, preferencialmente em empresas fabricantes de painéis elétricos. Experiência em vendas, fechamento de propostas e rotinas comerciais. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Brazil - Remote: Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. The Opportunity We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges: Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency. Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems. Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets. What You’ll Do You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks: Core Responsibilities High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models. System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems. Rapid Delivery: Adopt a ‘deliver fast’ mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards. Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more): Streaming & High-Throughput Data Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time. Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings. GenAI & Autonomous Agents Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating. Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers Graph & Knowledge Engineering Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data. Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal. The Technology Stack We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track. Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes. Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data. GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs. Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search). Desired Profile Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph. Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable. You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Must Haves: 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development. Advanced English communication skills. Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms. Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI). Good to Have: Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB). GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases. Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA). Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments. Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management. Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation. title: Principal Package Management Spec
description: Job Overview Principal Package Management Specialist utilizes their technical acumen, commercial acumen, management skills, and leadership skills to oversee all aspects of delivering a package from the cradle to the grave. Their core responsibility is ensuring the package is delivered on budget and on schedule while abiding by Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, and Security (QHSES) and project requirements. A successful Principal Package Management Specialist identifies risks and opportunities, sets up mitigation and captures plans accordingly. This entails developing a strategic outlook for the package and ensuring that all matters are resolved with the involvement of the right stakeholders and in a timely fashion. Principal Package Management Specialist must report status and outlook at an executive level to the Project Management team and, at times, Corporate Management. Responsibilities Deliver a package (purchase orders and/or subcontracts) on budget and schedule, and abide by QHSES and project requirements; complexity, criticality, and value of packages typically vary and are assigned and adjusted at the discretion of the function and project. Maintain a clear and thorough dialogue with the Project Management Team, and provide accurate and periodic status updates as well as both short and long-term outlooks. Identify risks and opportunities, and maintain a strategic outlook throughout the execution of the package; such discussion is to be held periodically with the Project Management team for buy-in. Maintain an accurate account of the package cost, commitments, changes, and forecast. Provide inputs and ensure alignment with Project Controls on current and forecasted cost and schedule. ROS dates to be analyzed with the schedulers to identify priorities and, if applicable, Installation Work Packages and Advance Work Packages to be set up and implemented. Track cost and schedule bid basis against actuals. Interface with all stakeholders to achieve package goals; stakeholders include but are not limited to the Supplier/Subcontractor, Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSES, Construction, Installation (if applicable), Commissioning, Joint Venture Partners, and, as needed, the client. Arrange and attend periodic status meetings with suppliers and clients as required. Manage formal correspondence with suppliers, clients, and other involved parties. Attend key meetings such as the progress meeting, kick-off meeting, PIM, and others. Oversee and enforce all day-to-day applicable processes involved and interface across various functions to identify and resolve any technical or commercial matters, and if unavoidable, then resolve any bottlenecks. Enforce the Management of Change process and Project Change Notices. Oversee the documentation process and manage priorities to ensure the most effective delivery from a cost and schedule aspect; this conversation must be coordinated between the suppliers, McDermott, and the client as applicable. Review key documents such as Technical Bid Evaluations, Commercial Bid Evaluations, Purchase Orders, and supplier data. Work with the end user to ensure alignment and expectations are met. Ensure that the prime contract flow downs are correctly administered, including variations. Oversee the planning, performance, and resource allocation of their team throughout the project. Could potentially report to the Package Manager or Senior Package Manager on a project. Develop and maintain contingency planning and lessons learned. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Engineering or Supply Chain Management (or a relevant discipline). 8-12 years of relevant experience (ideally in Engineering, Project/Package Management, Manufacturing, or similar). Technical knowledge of all phases of an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (EPCI) project and specific knowledge in the domain of the proposed packages is preferred. Commercial knowledge of contracts, purchase orders, and relevant disciplines within the Supply Chain function, such as proposals, purchasing, expediting, logistics, and material management. Strong understanding and adherence to QHSES requirements and ability to ensure compliance. Understands the requisitioning process from the bid stage through clarifications until Purchase Order award and post-award activities such as execution, receiving, and commissioning. Proactive attitude in determining opportunities and risks, particularly those attributed to Quality, Safety, Budget, and Schedule. Characteristics of a leader that naturally relates to all members of the team, from the floor to the project team and executive management. Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and public speaking skills. Willing to travel to various locations such as the shops, supplier offices and headquarters, job sites, labs, and other relevant locations as needed; at times, there may be a requirement for an extended deployment at a supplier’s location or the job site. PMP and/or PE is a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, and control to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking a mechanical technician with 3+ years' experience in lab and field testing of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for downhole drilling systems, including assembly, prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the hands‑on assembly, testing, and maintenance of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for our downhole drilling systems — running functional and performance tests in the lab and supporting prototype bring‑up, qualification campaigns, and operational deployments in the field. You will work alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers, capturing test data and feeding it back into design and reliability improvements. Responsibilities Conduct functional tests, performance evaluations, and calibrations on mechanical and electromechanical equipment to ensure compliance with quality standards and manufacturer specifications. Set up and operate test equipment — pressure and temperature test rigs, hydraulic test benches, torque tools, dimensional metrology (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and data acquisition systems — to run characterization, qualification, and acceptance testing. Diagnose and repair mechanical and hydraulic failures at the component and assembly level, including disassembly, inspection, replacement of worn or damaged parts, and rework of seals, fasteners, and fittings. Support prototype bring‑up and design iterations by capturing test data, flagging anomalies, and feeding observations back to mechanical and systems engineers. Assembly, Field Support & Documentation Assemble, disassemble, inspect, and perform preventative maintenance on mechanical and hydraulic equipment (downhole tools, actuators, drillstring components, pumps, valves, and associated test fixtures) according to technical specifications and procedures. Maintain accurate service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation, and generate clear reports on work performed and equipment status. Provide hands‑on support to field representatives and drilling crews during qualification campaigns and deployments, and travel to field locations when required. Coordinate with other technicians, engineers, and field representatives to resolve complex issues, support failure analysis, and ensure seamless equipment deployment. Help maintain an organized work environment and manage inventory of electronic components, parts, and supplies. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture, adhere to HSE regulations and quality procedures, and help maintain a safe, organized work environment (5S, housekeeping, waste segregation). What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 3+ years of experience working with mechanical and hydraulic equipment, preferably in an industrial or oilfield environment. Technical school certificate in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Proficiency with mechanical and hydraulic test equipment (pressure and temperature rigs, torque tools, hydraulic benches), dimensional metrology instruments (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and hand and power tools. Skilled in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including torque‑controlled fastening, seal and o‑ring installation, and alignment of rotating and reciprocating components. Ability to read, understand, and interpret technical manuals, drawings, schematics, blueprints, and engineering instructions. Experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical and hydraulic equipment and generating clear service and calibration reports. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Basic computer literacy and familiarity with data acquisition and diagnostic software, plus strong problem‑solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills. Customer Interface & Cross‑Functional Collaboration Experience working alongside engineers, field representatives, and drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and on‑site troubleshooting. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to capture lab and field test observations as clear, actionable feedback for engineering. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence High attention to detail and discipline in service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation. Ability to work independently or as part of a team, executing assigned tasks reliably against schedule and procedures. Contributes to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement based on test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast‑moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands‑on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable on the shop floor, in the lab, and at field locations as required, including travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping refine them as systems and processes mature. Adaptable and resilient in early‑stage and transitioning‑to‑commercial technology environments. Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback that improves equipment performance and reliability. Nice to have Associate degree or higher in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related discipline. Experience with downhole tools, drillstring components, or other oilfield mechanical equipment. Familiarity with calibration management systems and qualification testing standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high‑temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra‑deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: About this position Build your career with Kraken Robotics. Make a difference to others. Nice to have: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical fields. Professional Experience 3-6 years’ experience with high-level device software development, tools, and practices. Strong proficiency in Linux-based system development. Strong knowledge of modern C++ (C++14/17/20), STL, and object-oriented design. Experience writing automated tests: unit, integration and end-to-end. Familiarity with build systems (CMake, Make) and debugging tools (gdb, Valgrind). Experience using development tools and libraries such as Git, GTest. Familiarity with containerization using Docker. Nice to have Knowledge of basic electrical engineering concepts. Exposure to microservice development using gRPC/protobuf. Experience with Python. Familiarity with Agile Scrum methodologies. Experience with software‑hardware interaction and system‑level design. Exposure to CI/CD technologies, especially GitLab CI and/or Buildbot. Experience with Autoproj or other build systems for robotics. Experience with robotics frameworks (e.g., ROS or ROS2). Experience with simulation environments (e.g., Gazebo). Personal Skills Self‑motivated and capable of working independently. Ability to adapt to changing work environments and manage competing demands. Strong written and verbal communication skills. title: Profissional Program Planning
description: A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritório no Rio de janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, fazendo com que a Radix se consolide cada vez mais como uma empresa global. Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade? Como Profissional Program Planning você vai: Reporte e Governança do Programa Padronizar a forma como os gerentes de projeto reportam status, progresso, riscos, indicadores financeiros e desempenho. Simplificar e automatizar templates de reporte sempre que possível. Criar e manter dashboards executivos que demonstrem a saúde do programa em todos os projetos ativos. Estabelecer uma rotina consistente de reportes, incluindo reuniões semanais, quinzenais ou mensais, conforme necessário. Preparar consolidações e resumos do programa para a liderança e executivos. Garantir que os dados dos projetos sejam precisos, atualizados e acionáveis. Manter visibilidade sobre o desempenho financeiro do programa, incluindo orçamento, realizado, forecast, margem, burn rate e alocação de custos. Consolidar informações financeiras de múltiplos projetos em uma visão única do programa. Identificar lacunas relacionadas ao acompanhamento orçamentário, alocação de recursos, utilização de centros de custo, change orders e previsões financeiras. Sinalizar inconsistências para os gerentes de projeto e para a liderança do programa, permitindo ações corretivas. Apoiar os gerentes de projeto com recomendações quando houver desvios financeiros ou de entrega. Monitorar áreas compartilhadas entre projetos, incluindo recursos comuns, dependências cruzadas e custos não atribuídos. Gestão de Performance da Execução e Riscos Monitorar cronogramas, custos, mudanças de escopo, riscos, problemas, dependências e saúde das entregas em todo o programa. Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de revisão com os gerentes de projeto. Questionar reportes incompletos, pouco claros ou quando o desempenho estiver abaixo do esperado. Identificar riscos antecipadamente e escalá-los com recomendações objetivas. Apoiar a elaboração de planos de ação corretiva para projetos atrasados, acima do orçamento, com falta de recursos ou sem responsáveis claramente definidos. Garantir que riscos, problemas e mudanças contratuais sejam identificados com antecedência suficiente para que a liderança possa atuar. Planejamento de Recursos e Capacidade Apoiar o planejamento de recursos e previsões de capacidade do programa. Monitorar se os recursos estão corretamente alocados aos projetos e centros de custo. Identificar situações de subalocação, sobrealocação e lacunas entre demanda e capacidade disponível. Apoiar a liderança na previsão de necessidades futuras de contratação com base no pipeline de projetos e compromissos de entrega. Ferramentas, Automação e Dados Utilizar ferramentas como Power BI, Pipedrive, Excel e outras plataformas de automação e reporte para aumentar a visibilidade e reduzir esforços manuais. Criar ou aprimorar dashboards que forneçam visibilidade em tempo real ou próxima do tempo real sobre o desempenho dos projetos e do programa. Promover melhorias contínuas nos processos de reporte, templates e qualidade dos dados. Trabalhar em parceria com gerentes de projeto, equipe financeira e liderança para tornar os dados do programa mais confiáveis e úteis para tomada de decisão. Para essa vaga, você deve ter: Experiência em suporte à gestão de projetos, gestão de programas, PMO, controle de projetos ou operações. Sólido entendimento de indicadores financeiros de projetos, incluindo orçamento, realizado, forecast, burn rate, margem e change orders. Capacidade de consolidar informações de múltiplos projetos e identificar tendências, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Forte experiência com Power BI, Excel e ferramentas de reporting/dashboard. Capacidade de trabalhar com gerentes de projeto e liderança para melhorar a qualidade dos reportes e a responsabilização dos envolvidos. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e conforto para questionar informações incompletas ou inconsistentes. Capacidade de atuar em um ambiente em crescimento e dinâmico, onde processos ainda estão sendo estruturados e aprimorados. title: Senior Director
description: Requisition ID: 50092 Business Unit: Fitch Ratings Category: Credit Analysis & Research Location: São Paulo, BR; Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR Senior Director, Latin American Corporates, Infrastructure & Project Finance (CIPF) – Energy, Power & Utilities We will Count on You To: Lead coverage of a portfolio across the Energy, Power & Utilities sectors in Latin America, with a particular focus on Brazil. Have direct managerial responsibility for analysts within the team, providing leadership, coaching, and development support while fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture. Oversee the analysis of key quantitative and qualitative factors influencing credit quality across corporates and project finance entities in the sector. Supervise the maintenance, and review of detailed financial models and credit analyses used to support rating recommendations. Chair and participate actively in internal rating committees, presenting clear and well-supported rating recommendations for both international and national scale ratings, where applicable. Serve as a senior point of contact for external market participants, including issuers, investors, bankers, advisors, and other stakeholders in the rating process. Articulate Fitch’s credit views, rating rationales, and sector outlook in a clear, engaging, and commercially aware manner through meetings, conference calls, written commentary, and published research. Contribute to the strategic direction and visibility of Fitch’s Latin America CIPF franchise , including representing Fitch in conferences, industry forums, and client events. Support the management of the regional portfolio across multiple regulatory environments, ensuring high analytical standards, consistency, and timeliness in rating actions and research output. Partner closely with colleagues across sectors, countries, and analytical groups to advance the One CIPF approach and strengthen Fitch’s market presence across Latin America. Write and oversee timely, insightful research on sector trends, market developments, and topical credit issues affecting the Energy, Power & Utilities space. Mentor and develop junior team members, helping to build analytical depth and succession within the franchise. What You Need to Have: 10+ years of relevant experience in credit analysis, project finance, capital markets, corporate or investment banking, or a related field. Strong knowledge of the Energy, Power & Utilities sectors, ideally including exposure to regulated utilities, power generation, transmission, renewables, and/or midstream or energy infrastructure assets. Demonstrated experience managing people and/or leading teams in an analytical environment. Solid understanding of financial statement analysis, credit fundamentals, and debt capital structures. Proven ability to assess and explain analytically complex topics with sound judgment and intellectual rigor. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluency in English and Portuguese required; Spanish strongly preferred. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, master’s degree, CFA, CPA, or other advanced professional qualification preferred. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility with internal and external stakeholders. What Would Make You Stand Out: Deep knowledge of, and strong interest in, the Brazilian Energy, Power & Utilities sectors, with a desire to continue expanding expertise across related corporate and project finance subsectors. A strong professional background in capital markets and/or credit analysis, supported by well-developed financial statement analysis and credit assessment skills. Demonstrated interest in deepening exposure to and understanding of the debt capital markets, particularly as they relate to Latin American issuers and infrastructure assets. A clear pattern of leadership, with the ability to proactively and effectively engage with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally. Presence, judgment, and communication skills to represent Fitch credibly with issuer management teams, investors, bankers, and market participants. A collaborative mindset and a strong commitment to mentoring junior analysts and contributing to the development of the broader team. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? title: Bijbaan International Tax in Amsterdam
description: Als jij het in je hebt, krijg je bij Grant Thornton meteen alle ruimte. Om je talent te laten zien. Om baanbrekend werk te verzetten voor toonaangevende klanten. Of het nu gaat om belastingadvies, (duurzame) verslaglegging, cybersecurity of impactdashboards: we willen dat jij impact maakt. Want bij ons draait het om jou: niet alleen kun je helemaal jezelf zijn, maar je wordt vanaf het begin serieus genomen. Je draait volop mee, met de verantwoordelijkheid die daarbij hoort en de juiste begeleiding. Jij krijgt de kans je potentieel meteen te laten zien. Onze unieke cultuur creëert een omgeving waarin je je empowered voelt om die extra stap te zetten. En we moedigen diversiteit en inclusie aan zodat iedereen zich bij ons thuis voelt. In jouw bijbaan Tax bij Grant Thornton duik je in de wereld van internationale belastingen. Je ondersteunt je collega’s bij het voorbereiden van adviezen over internationale belastingvraagstukken. Je helpt mee met het uitwerken van vaktechnische onderwerpen en stelt eenvoudige aangiften vennootschapsbelasting op. Zo doe je waardevolle praktijkervaring op in een internationale omgeving, terwijl je jezelf stap voor stap ontwikkelt naast je studie. Je zet jouw eerste stappen in de wereld van International Tax en groeit elke dag een stukje verder in het vak. Samen met ervaren collega’s werk je aan internationale fiscale vraagstukken voor klanten in allerlei sectoren, van gaming tot de dienstensector. Daarbij krijg je de begeleiding én ruimte die je nodig hebt om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je leert niet alleen hoe je klanten het beste kunt adviseren, maar ontdekt ook hoe leuk het is om samen te werken met collega’s van internationale kantoren. Zo combineer je praktijkervaring met klantcontact en bouw je stap voor stap aan een stevige basis voor je toekomst. Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit: Opstellen van (eenvoudige) aangiften vennootschapsbelasting; Assisteren bij het opstellen van internationale belastingadviezen; Voorbereiden en uitwerken van internationale fiscale vraagstukken; Coördineren van btw-registraties en klantvragen in diverse landen; Ondersteunen van collega's bij complexe belastingvraagstukken. Wat neem je mee? Je volgt een wo-master Fiscaal recht of Fiscale economie, of hebt deze afgerond; Je bent minimaal 3 maanden beschikbaar, met een inzet van ten minste 2 dagen per week; Je hebt affiniteit met international tax en bent enthousiast om te leren; Je werkt accuraat, systematisch en integer; Je bent communicatief vaardig in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Over het team Werken bij International Tax Services (ITS) betekent werken in een enthousiast, levendig en divers team van 20 collega’s. Vanaf dag één draai je mee op grote internationale klantdossiers. Je krijgt snel verantwoordelijkheid, maar staat er nooit alleen voor. De lijnen zijn kort, ook met partners, en je werkt samen met verschillende collega’s, niet alleen je Development Manager. Dankzij wekelijkse vaktechnische overleggen, 1-op-1 begeleiding en de mogelijkheid tot internationale secondments, groei je snel in je rol én als mens. Je werkt op ons kantoor in Amsterdam, verdeeld over twee open verdiepingen met uitzicht op de Johan Cruijff ArenA en de Ziggo Dome. Een inspirerende plek waar je samenwerkt met collega’s uit alle disciplines aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Wat bieden wij jou? Jouw carrière. Jouw keuze. Bij Grant Thornton krijg je de ruimte om te ontdekken, te groeien en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je wordt actief begeleid door een mentor en werkt in een omgeving waar persoonlijke aandacht en professionele groei centraal staan. We geloven in vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid zodat jij het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. Salaris van € 18,29 per uur, inclusief vakantietoeslag; Begeleiding door een Development Manager waar je altijd terecht kunt. Grant Thornton is een netwerkorganisatie van wereldniveau. Internationaal zijn we één van de grootste accountants- en adviesorganisaties, een zevende plek wereldwijd! Hier in Nederland hebben we de fantastische voordelen van een kleinere organisatie met open cultuur, met de internationale mogelijkheden en multiculturele ervaring van één van de grootste organisaties ter wereld. Wij gaan altijd een stapje verder. Voor onze klanten en vooral ook voor jou. Zodat jij de allerbeste werkomgeving hebt, die inclusief is en waar we flink bezig zijn met duurzaamheid. We werken voor profit- én non-profitorganisaties. Specialiseer je zoals jij wilt en werk zo iedere dag aan een wereld die past bij jouw idealen en doelen. Solliciteer vandaag nog en ontdek hoe jij kunt groeien én bijdragen bij Grant Thornton! Meer weten over deze rol of werken bij Grant Thornton? Anne Baas of ) staat klaar om je verder te helpen. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Wayfinding and Signage Manager
description: Wayfinding and Signage Manager Department: Technical & Infrastructure Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. THE POSITION The Wayfinding and Signage Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Wayfinding and Signage Manager is responsible for leading the wayfinding and signage implementation, operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class wayfinding and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027, ensuring that the wayfinding and signage is up to FIFA quality standards. They will be initially responsible for the technical development of wayfinding signage guidelines and principles in collaboration with the contracted provider(s), department senior team and the other Cluster Managers. Subsequently, the candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at stadiums and other official sites. In all aspects of their role, they will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations, ensuring that they are managed efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. In addition, they will take guidance from other cluster managers to ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027. Providing expertise in assisting in the compilation of technical wayfinding signage guidelines, principles and templates. Inputting into the development of the wayfinding signage system(s) used to assist with the planning of the project. Providing strategic input into the development and implementation of the wayfinding signage kit of parts to be utilized at all official sites. Overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 stadiums in Brazil. Working with other Cluster Managers ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all sites within the sites. Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of allocated wayfinding operations and reporting updates to senior department members. Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaising with site owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Attending department‑specific and organization site visits at both assigned sites and potentially additional official sites. Acting as the main wayfinding point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project. Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against. Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. YOUR PROFILE Relevant experience in delivering wayfinding and signage projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. and experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive wayfinding and signage related activities. Experience in devising technical guidelines and wayfinding signage kit of parts for large‑scale events. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) Strong understanding of stadium wayfinding and signage requirements and large‑scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi‑fased events and projects. Experience in managing providers of services for world‑class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organisations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education). Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Teya Senior Machine Learning Engineer you will build models and decision systems that turn Teya's data into better outcomes for our customers and our business. You will work in the AI Research & Development team partnering with engineers, product managers, and domain experts to take problems from framing through model development and into reliable, monitored production systems. Responsibilities Frame ambiguous business problems as well-posed modeling, inference, or optimization tasks, and choose methods that fit the data and the decision. Design, build, validate, and deploy predictive and decisioning models across areas such as fraud and risk monitoring, customer onboarding and due diligence, pricing, and customer lifetime value. Run rigorous experiments and causal analyses, including A/B testing, uplift modeling, and offline evaluation, to measure whether models actually move the outcomes that matter. Engineer features and build the data pipelines that feed training and serving, with attention to leakage, reproducibility, and data quality. Productionise models with strong attention to validation, backtesting, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining, so performance holds up after launch. Work closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to identify where modeling creates value and to integrate models into products and operational workflows. Apply optimization and operations research methods where decisions, not just predictions, are the goal. Contribute to modeling standards, evaluation practices, and reusable tooling across the team. Stay current with developments in machine learning and statistics, and apply new methods where they earn their place. Requirements Strong foundations in statistics and machine learning, with the judgment to match methods to problems. Proficiency in Python and its data and ML ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), and strong SQL. Hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in production, not only in notebooks. Solid command of supervised and unsupervised learning, including methods such as gradient boosting, regularised regression, and clustering, with a clear understanding of model evaluation and overfitting. Experience with experimentation and inference, including A/B testing and the basics of causal estimation. Experience with cloud platforms and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, APIs, monitoring, infrastructure as code). Strong software engineering fundamentals including testing, reproducibility, and maintainability. Ability to communicate quantitative findings and their business implications clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Nice to have Experience building models in regulated industries such as payments, fintech, banking, risk, compliance, or fraud prevention. Experience with use cases such as: Fraud detection and anomaly detection Credit and onboarding risk decisioning Pricing and customer lifetime value modeling Churn and propensity modeling Forecasting and time series Recommendation and personalisation Background in operations research, mathematical programming, or stochastic optimization. Knowledge of MLOps, model lifecycle management, feature stores, monitoring, and governance. Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow where the problem warrants them. Familiarity with data engineering concepts, analytics platforms, and experimentation frameworks. Contributions to the ML or statistics community through open source, research, or technical writing.
